question_text: Which demo booth attracted bigger crowds — NVIDIA or Intel? Roughly how much more popular was the winner?
answer_text: NVIDIA attracted bigger crowds: weighted average headcount 15.52 vs Intel 10.65 (absolute difference 4.87, 37.2% higher). These figures are for cameras with camera_location containing "NVIDIA" and "Intel" during 2025-12-08T00:00:00Z–2025-12-09T00:00:00Z; peak headcounts were 86 (NVIDIA) and 53 (Intel), with 86400 samples for each.

citations.cypher:
CALL {
  MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)-[:AT_CAMERA]->(cam:Camera)
  WHERE cam.camera_location CONTAINS 'NVIDIA'
    AND ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
  RETURN 'NVIDIA' AS booth,
         sum(ch.event_count) AS total_samples,
         sum(ch.avg_hc * ch.event_count) AS weighted_heads,
         avg(ch.avg_hc) AS mean_hourly_avg,
         max(ch.peak_hc) AS peak_hc
  UNION ALL
  MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)-[:AT_CAMERA]->(cam:Camera)
  WHERE cam.camera_location CONTAINS 'Intel'
    AND ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
  RETURN 'Intel' AS booth,
         sum(ch.event_count) AS total_samples,
         sum(ch.avg_hc * ch.event_count) AS weighted_heads,
         avg(ch.avg_hc) AS mean_hourly_avg,
         max(ch.peak_hc) AS peak_hc
}
WITH collect({booth: booth, total_samples: total_samples, weighted_heads: weighted_heads, mean_hourly_avg: mean_hourly_avg, peak_hc: peak_hc}) AS rows
WITH head([x IN rows WHERE x.booth = 'NVIDIA']) AS n, head([x IN rows WHERE x.booth = 'Intel']) AS i
WITH n, i,
CASE
  WHEN n IS NULL AND i IS NULL THEN 'no_data'
  WHEN n IS NULL THEN i.booth
  WHEN i IS NULL THEN n.booth
  WHEN (CASE WHEN n.total_samples IS NULL OR n.total_samples = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE toFloat(n.weighted_heads) / toFloat(n.total_samples) END) >= (CASE WHEN i.total_samples IS NULL OR i.total_samples = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE toFloat(i.weighted_heads) / toFloat(i.total_samples) END) THEN n.booth
  ELSE i.booth
END AS winner,
CASE WHEN n IS NULL THEN 0.0 WHEN n.total_samples IS NULL OR n.total_samples = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE toFloat(n.weighted_heads) / toFloat(n.total_samples) END AS n_weighted_avg,
CASE WHEN i IS NULL THEN 0.0 WHEN i.total_samples IS NULL OR i.total_samples = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE toFloat(i.weighted_heads) / toFloat(i.total_samples) END AS i_weighted_avg,
n.peak_hc AS n_peak, i.peak_hc AS i_peak, n.total_samples AS n_samples, i.total_samples AS i_samples
RETURN winner,
       n.booth AS booth_nvidia, round(n_weighted_avg, 2) AS avg_headcount_nvidia, n_peak AS peak_nvidia, n_samples AS samples_nvidia,
       i.booth AS booth_intel, round(i_weighted_avg, 2) AS avg_headcount_intel, i_peak AS peak_intel, i_samples AS samples_intel,
       round(abs(n_weighted_avg - i_weighted_avg), 2) AS absolute_avg_difference,
       CASE WHEN (n_weighted_avg + i_weighted_avg) = 0.0 THEN 0.0 ELSE round(abs(n_weighted_avg - i_weighted_avg) / ((n_weighted_avg + i_weighted_avg) / 2.0) * 100, 2) END AS percent_difference
